stable.notes: Four bundled Jedi now sit inside one searchable 304-character gallery, with advanced animated packs clearly marked. Pet settings and state sprites are nested to keep the menu compact. The collapsed pet keeps one stable viewport, only the chevron expands sessions, and an enabled pet remains idle when no sessions are active. Miles Windu adds four directed V7 story loops: running bridges the one- and two-session fights, three-session combat keeps one saber and persistent droids, and the five-droid swarm now blocks before contact. All four loops use transparent, guttered frames with exact opening/closing seams. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
